existing_source_audit.actual_footage: physical sleeved cards in binder pages; cards remain in physical pockets and some are handled. No permanent overlay in every frame, but visible SAMPLE card graphic overlays occlude binder regions in several sampled frames.
existing_source_audit.per_frame_observation: At least two binder spreads are visible across the eight selected frames; adjacent frames repeat the same physical page/card instances, so frame count is not physical-instance count. Full spread has roughly a dozen-to-high-teens pocket cards, but exact instance count is not asserted due partial edges and overlay occlusion. Several card names/art are legible; set numbers are too small to treat as identity evidence.
existing_source_audit.quality: 4K source 3840x2160; cards in page views occupy roughly 400-500px short edge, adequate for localization candidates. Sleeve glare/reflections moderate; one early view is strongly hand-occluded. More than one burned-in SAMPLE graphic is not a physical card.
existing_source_audit.identity: No ground-truth identity labels added; visual text seen in footage is not treated as catalog truth.
existing_source_audit.sampled_physical_instances: At least one visible page has about a dozen pocketed cards; adjacent sampled frames repeat cards and pages. Exact unique-instance count across the excerpt is not asserted.

additional_acquisition.observed_format: 3840x2160, 30fps VP9; extracted via public unauthenticated yt-dlp section download; section cut is keyframe/container based and requested times are provenance, not frame-accurate timestamp verification.
additional_acquisition.observation: At least one full binder spread with many individual physical sleeved cards (about 12 clearly visible across the sampled spread; other partial pockets may add instances), and a separate held physical card filling much of the 4K frame. In the close-up the card artwork, printed name, and printed set-number area are visually readable; exact identity is not promoted as dataset truth. Foil glare is strong on the handled parallel. A persistent host picture-in-picture overlays the lower-right image area; it is an on-screen graphic, not a physical card. One sampled spread also includes a burned-in SAMPLE card graphic; this is an on-screen overlay, separate from the physical held card and binder pockets.
additional_acquisition.comparative_decision: Better for close single-card scale and readable text than the existing wide binder excerpt, while worse for clean unobstructed full-page detection because of the persistent host inset and hand/foil glare. Keep as supplemental, do not replace existing binder source. No further acquisition needed for this bounded check.
additional_acquisition.reuse_basis: inspection_only; reuse not established; not promoted to training

detector_audit.note: Frame-local detections; repeated held card, host inset and source overlay can contribute. Not distinct-card counts or box labels.
